assign.title: Fix task "Session page: Overview, Timeline and Tasks tabs show nothing for this session" (record: /framework/ai/sessions
Session page: voice sessions no longer stall Overview/Timeline/Tasks/Board/Coverage; More popover closes on a second tap
assign.outcome: Every voice session's page (id like "v-9dvbbrn", not a uuid) was permanently stuck: AISessionDetail.content()/log_urls() gated SessionWork's `ready` promise (SessionStats, SessionOutlineView, SessionOverview all wait on it), SessionTasks and AISessionCoverage behind a uuid-only regex meant only for the Claude-Code transcript tail. A voice id always failed it, so `ready` never resolved: Overview stuck on "Reading...", Timeline stuck on "no events", Tasks/Board/Coverage empty, and the sticky stats bar rendered as an empty unhidden strip (the reported white sliver) instead of hiding itself. Fixed by using the page's own known dated folder (`segs`) instead of requiring a uuid. Separately: the More dropdown (ux/Popover, wrapped by SessionPopover) never closed on a second tap of its own anchor — a native 'auto' popover light-dismisses on pointerdown before the click handler's toggle() ran, so it reopened instead of closing; Board/Coverage 'doing nothing' was the same root cause (permanently blank panels), not a broken click. Fixed by capturing open-state on pointerdown.
